Just created a pull request to solve for this @Kickingbird3 .
The PR will disable these new features on SimpliSafe 2. It would be great if you could test it out for me when they're merged and added to the next beta, thanks!

review_comments: This is messy. Just return from the update if the system version isn't 3.

The reason why I did it this way is because the `await system.update()` call already existed before I added sensor support, and I thought there would be a reason for it.

What I changed vs the original is the argument `cached=False`.

If you don't think there's any reasons to return something on `async_update_system(system)` for SimpliSafe 2 systems, then yes, I can update it following your suggestion.

What do you think @bachya ?
I see; thanks for that clarification. In that case, let's stick with what you have.
